newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Worldxchange looks to float in Australia in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Worldxchange looks to float in Australia in 1998.

text.p: Discount telephone company Worldxchange Pty Ltd said on Thursday it plans to float on the Australian Stock Exchange, possibly in calendar 1998.

"We are going to wait until Optus and Telstra have had their floats. We don't caught up in the noise, so I would think it would be sometime next year," Worldxchange chief executive Richard Vincent told Reuters.
Asked if he thought Worldxchange's market value would be over A$100 million, Vincent replied: "I would think so."
The group is 60 percent owned by Worldxchange of the United States and 40 percent by the Asia Infrastructure Fund.
